title: fix(app-shell,plugin-designer,types,i18n): retire the field designer's Indexed toggle
body:
Fixes #4644 — `target:v17` board item.

## The contradiction

The Studio field designer offered an **Indexed** toggle for a key the contract refuses by name. From the card's captured GA round trip (`@objectstack/console` 17.0.0, real browser, downstream objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1122):

```
PUT /api/v1/meta/object/probe_widget?mode=draft&package=com.probe.p1154
→ HTTP 422
{"error":"[invalid_metadata] object/probe_widget failed spec validation:
  fields.owner_id: Unrecognized key(s) on this field: `indexed`. …",
 "code":"INVALID_METADATA"}
```

Re-measured on this branch against the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0-rc.6:

| field payload | `FieldSchema.safeParse` |
| --- | --- |
| `{name,label,type}` (control) | success |
| `+ indexed: true` | **`unrecognized_keys`** — "never a FieldSchema key; a field-level index flag built no index (#2377). Declare the index in the object's `indexes[]`." |
| `+ externalId: true` | success |
| `+ trackHistory: true` | success |

The card asked whether `External ID` was a sibling defect. **Measured: it is not** — `externalId` and `trackHistory` both parse. `indexed` was the only rejected key among the ADVANCED checkboxes.

The defect is not the 422, which is loud and correct. It is that the designer offered a control whose only reachable outcome was a blocked save — and, because the key is *stored*, every later save of that object stayed blocked until the author found and un-ticked it.

## What changed

Per the admission ruling: the control and its write path come out, no client-side re-acceptance of `indexed`, no flag-hiding.

**The control, in both field designers.** The card names `ObjectFieldInspector` (its ADVANCED section is what the GA bundle's `label:c('designer.field.indexed') … onCommit:e=> D({indexed:e||void 0})` minifies from). Re-deriving the class turned up a **second live control on the same route**: `plugin-designer`'s `FieldDesigner` advanced section, whose `MetadataFieldsPage` saves through the identical `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name`. Both are retired.

**The write paths.** `MetadataFieldsPage.fromDesignerField`, `MetadataService.toFieldPayload` and `metadataConverters.toFieldDefinition` each authored or forwarded the key; all three stop. `DesignerFieldDefinition.indexed` is removed from `@object-ui/types`, so nothing can re-declare it silently.

**The labels.** `designer.field.indexed` (en + zh), `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.indexed`, and the `indexed` entry in all ten locale packs.

**Stale drafts stop blocking saves.** This is the ruling's explicit measure, and the answer was that the payload builder does *not* strip unknown keys — `readFields` preserves them deliberately and every write path spreads what it read (`{ ...def, ...patch }`), so a previously-ticked draft carried the key straight back out with no control left on screen to clear it. The key is now stripped **on load** — not migrated — at `readFields`, the single read door for `draft.fields` across the whole object designer (inspector, form designer, design surface, settings / validations / API panels), so one strip covers every writer. `MetadataFieldsPage` gets the same treatment on the keys it carries over from the stored def. Same shape as `PermissionAdvancedFacets`' `RETIRED_RLS_KEYS` (objectstack#7130), and keyed to the tombstone alone: every other unknown key on a field definition still survives the round trip (pinned).

Object-level `indexes: [{ name, fields, unique }]`, materialised by `SqlDriver.syncDeclaredIndexes`, is untouched — a test pins that a save preserves it.

## Scope note — the class closure beyond the claimed surface

The claim declared `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` + i18n keys + tests. The retirement of `indexed` from `plugin-designer`, `MetadataService`, `metadataConverters` and `@object-ui/types` is a **bounded in-place class closure**: same defect class (the same key, the same route, the same 422), the correct form pinned verbatim by the landed ruling ("a designer must not offer a key the contract refuses"), mechanical deletions, no file held by another in-flight claim (checked against #4640 `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, #4508 core chart-series, #4648 parity/registry — all disjoint), and no new gate family. Leaving the second designer shipping the control would have left the ruling only half true. The file surface is amended on the issue.

## Out of scope — filed, not fixed

The same probe found `placeholder` is **also** rejected by `FieldSchema` ("never a FieldSchema key. Author hint text through `inlineHelpText` or `description`"), and both designers author it. It is deliberately **not** fixed here: unlike `indexed` — which is inert everywhere — `placeholder` is genuinely consumed by the designer's own form preview (`object-fields-bridge.ts` maps it into the rendered preview field), so the correct form is a contract question (retire the control vs. add the key to the spec) rather than a mechanical deletion. Filed separately; see the issue comment.

## Verification

All at `a120228a9` (final commit), repo-root vitest per AGENTS.md §9:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ packages/app-shell/src/services/ packages/app-shell/src/utils/ packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` → **215 files, 2167 passed, 1 skipped**
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-designer/ packages/types/ packages/i18n/` → **88 files, 1273 passed**
- full `packages/app-shell/` (400 files, 3777 passed, 1 skipped) at `3c645b54d` — byte-identical for app-shell to `a120228a9` (`git diff --name-only 3c645b54d a120228a9 -- packages/app-shell/` is empty)
- `type-check` for app-shell · plugin-designer · types · i18n → all Done, with the dependency closure built first
- `check:i18n-keys` → OK (2928 en keys, every call-site key resolves); `check:i18n-drift` → OK ("1 removed — those are all-locales-key-parity's"); `all-locales-key-parity` green inside the i18n run
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-fixed` → all OK
- `eslint` over the changed files → 0 errors (25 pre-existing warnings, none on added lines)

**Reverse verification, both halves.** With the six source files reverted to `origin/main` and the new tests kept: **13 of 14 red**. The one that stayed green is the identity guard ("returns the original def object when there is nothing to strip"), which holds either way by design. Restored from the branch afterwards; `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Type-narrowing reverse check** (proves tsc read the rebuilt `.d.ts`, not a cached one): adding `indexed: true` to a `DesignerFieldDefinition` literal goes red —

```
TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties,
        and 'indexed' does not exist in type 'DesignerFieldDefinition'.
```

— then restored.

Downstream consumer sweep (**prefix form**, `...@object-ui/types` direction): `DesignerFieldDefinition` has exactly three consumer packages — `app-shell`, `plugin-designer`, `types` — all type-checked green above.

Consumer-visible, so a changeset is included; `minor` per the fixed-group rule (breaking semantics described in the body, never `major`).
